NEW at stage 4 (replaces 句 / 半行诗 of stages 1-3): Chinese scholarship on Arabic poetry counts in 联. zh.wikipedia 悬诗, citing 仲跻昆《阿拉伯文学通史》p. 56: «一联两句……每联押韵», «全诗共104联». A bayt is 一联诗 / 这联诗 / 第三联; the opening half-line is 这半联诗; plain 诗 where the source says 'what Tarafa was first to say' without the word verse. 半联 itself is derived from 联 (the cited page calls the two halves 上下句). [verified]
